'''Walking Villager Heads''' are [[Walking Heads]] of [[Assimilated Villager|Assimilated Villagers]].

==''Spawning''==
* Spawned with a 50% chance when an Assimilated Villager dies.
* Spawned by [[Worm|Worms]] through Level 3 [[Scent System|Scents]].

==''Behavior''==
Walking Villager Heads are cowardly Melee swarm units.

* Walking Villager Heads' Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
* Walking Villager Heads can perform small leaps.
* They will seek out [[Medium Incomplete Form|Medium Incomplete Forms]] to merge with in order to evolve back into Assimilated Villagers.
* Any Mob within 3 blocks of a Walking Villager Head will be inflicted with [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]]. This does not go through walls.
* Walking Villager Heads can traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.

{{Variants|customdesc=*Walking Villager Heads have 1 variant, spawning from the <span style="color:#AAAAAA;">Nocturn</span> variant of the Assimilated Villager:|count=1|Texture=Assimilated_Villager_HeadV.png|TextureDesc=has identical stats.}}
=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Walking Villager Heads, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* Walking Villager Heads will run away during the daytime if no other Parasites are present.
